chapter: Union, publishers, race and Harlem nightlife
title: Playing across from Whiteman at Roseland; white bands with black players
summary: They played opposite Whiteman at Roseland; Dorsey featured Charlie Shavers.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What other white bands? Did Benny Goodman appear there?
What about Tommy Dorsey? Or what white bands do you remember playing up there? Paul Whiteman?

Across from the Roseland when it first opened. I told you that the other night. The Beer Barrel Polka came out. Just in front of the Roseland, just opposite, one on one side and one on the other. And they had two bands.
Did any of those white bands in the 30's hire black musicians?
Did Tommy Dorsey have black musicians?
I don't know what year but he used to feature Charlie Shavers.
I don't remember that. He didn't need nothing but what he had, because he had the best band there for a white man, playing the kind of music he played. He was just fine.
